t: Ready-to-use on interior surfaces. It can be used over new or renovated substrates and offers a smooth finish that helps to enhance the appearance of paint finishes. No need to spot prime. Can be used on painted or unpainted surfaces: gypsum plaster, plasterboards, old painted surfaces, any type of filler, cement and concrete. Ready to overpaint in 8 hours.
b: For Fine Smoothing over Small Defects
